## Checklist

- [ ] JSON file(s) placed under `spectra/<category>/`
- [ ] `measurement_type`, `date`, and `id` are correct
- [ ] Wavelength values are in nm and strictly increasing
- [ ] Spectral values match the declared `scale` (`fractional` 0–1 or `percent` 0–100)
- [ ] Copyright / attribution included in `metadata.copyright` if required by the data source
- [ ] CI validation check passes (green tick on this PR)
